name: Grain Delay
description: A delay whose repeats are rebuilt from grains: pitch-shifted, scattered in time and space, optionally reversed; with feedback each repeat climbs or falls again.

params.name: Time
params.description: How far behind the input the grains play, which is the delay time of the repeat.

params.name: Spray
params.description: Makes each grain arrive a random amount later than Time. Low keeps the repeat tight; high smears it into a wash.

params.name: Pitch
params.description: Transposes the repeats. With Feedback each repeat is shifted again, so they climb or fall in steps.

params.name: Pitch Spray
params.description: Gives each grain its own random detune. Low thickens the repeat; high scatters it across as much as an octave either way.

params.name: Size
params.description: How long each grain lasts. Short grains are grainy and tight in time; long grains are smoother and keep more of the phrase.

params.name: Density
params.description: How many grains overlap at once. Low lets the repeat pulse with gaps between grains; high is smoother and more even.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: Share of grains that play backwards. Zero is all forwards; full is all backwards.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: Sends the repeats back into the delay. Higher settings give more repeats, each one pitched and scattered again.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Darkens the repeats. It sits in the feedback loop, so each repeat loses more highs than the last.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Throws each grain to a random place between left and right. Higher settings make the repeats wider.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the grain repeats.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit (kit::GrainPool over a delay line). In the family of granular pitch delays (the 'crystals' of rack harmonizers and the grain delays of DAWs); not a model of any unit.
